title: Square root scaling equivalence
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with a probability mass function $\pi$ that assigns positive mass to every point. Coordinatewise multiplication by $\sqrt{\pi(x)}$ defines a real linear equivalence from the space of real-valued functions on $\Omega$ to Euclidean space indexed by $\Omega$.
